original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹西赤道州78名被绑架平民获释
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹西赤道州朱巴-蒙德里公路沿线至少78名平民遭绑架后被释放，部分人已被扣押长达四天。一名地方官员和多名幸存者向Radio Tamazuj描述了伏击经过，称武装人员抢劫并焚烧车辆，将人质带入丛林。有幸存者认为袭击者与某个反对派武装组织有关，但这一说法无法得到独立证实。

location.raw_text: Juba-Mundri road in Western Equatoria State

key_facts.fact: 至少78名平民在朱巴-蒙德里公路沿线被绑架后获释
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At least 78 civilians abducted along the Juba-Mundri road in Western Equatoria State have been released after spending up to four days in captivity

key_facts.fact: 被绑架者于9月26日在朱巴-蒙德里公路旅行时遭绑架
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The civilians were abducted on 26 September while travelling along the Juba-Mundri road, he said.

key_facts.fact: 蒙德里东县执行主任称约40人于周三凌晨5点左右抵达警察局，包括29名男子和11名妇女及儿童
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: about 40 people arrived at a police station on Wednesday at about 5am. The group included 29 men and 11 women, including children

key_facts.fact: 幸存者称武装人员抢劫乘客财物并焚烧部分车辆
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: several vehicles were stopped and passengers were robbed of money, phones and other belongings. Some vehicles were also burned, including a Land Cruiser

key_facts.fact: 有幸存者认为袭击者与某个反对派武装组织有关，但无法独立核实
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: some survivors believed the attackers were associated with an opposition armed group, but this could not be independently verified

key_facts.fact: 当地官员称没有信息表明任何被绑架者遇害
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Papa said there was no information to suggest that any of those abducted had been killed.

uncertainties: 被绑架女性是否遭受性暴力尚无法确认，幸存者称因男女被分开而不知情
袭击者是否与反对派武装组织有关联尚未得到独立证实
目前仅有一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，缺乏交叉验证
